title: CUET Prep practice paper: Geography, set 1

rights.statement: Every question in this paper was written for CUET Prep and is owned by it. It is not a previous-year paper and contains no question from any examination paper.

questions.stem:

questions.stem: Which statement best distinguishes human geography from physical geography?

options.label: A
options.text: Human geography studies natural features such as landforms, while physical geography studies human activities and their patterns

options.label: B
options.text: Human geography studies only the past, while physical geography studies only the present day

options.label: C
options.text: Physical geography is not considered to be a part of the discipline of geography at all

options.label: D
options.text: Human geography studies human activities and their spatial patterns, while physical geography studies natural features

questions.stem:
Consider the following statements.
A. Environmental determinism holds that human activity is controlled by nature.
B. Possibilism sees the environment as offering possibilities that people use according to their culture and technology.
C. Neo-determinism says that human beings are completely free of the environment.
D. The term possibilism was given by Lucien Febvre.
Which of the statements are correct?
